name: eucalypt
description: Reagent compatible-ish Squint-cljs library with no React. Builds tiny frontends.

scripts.size: pnpm dist:build | grep -v squint; gzip -c eucalypt.mjs > eucalypt.mjs.gz; ls -alh eucalypt.mjs.gz; rm eucalypt.mjs.gz
scripts.test: pnpm clean; pnpm test:compile && vitest run --config src/test/vitest.config.js
scripts.test:reagent-all:
failures=0; for f in src/test/src/*.test.cljs; do if [ "$f" != "src/test/src/eucalypt_extensions.test.cljs" ]; then echo "=== $f ==="; if ! timeout 10s npx nbb src/test/reagent-runner/runreagent.cljs "$f"; then failures=$((failures + 1)); fi; fi; done; if [ $failures -ne 0 ]; then echo "
❌ $failures test file(s) failed with real Reagent"; exit 1; fi
scripts.demo:build: cd src/demo && squint compile && vite build && SRC=small.html vite build && SRC=games.html vite build
scripts.report: pnpm clean; echo "Branch: `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`"; pnpm test | grep -v squint | grep -E '(pass|fail)'; echo "LOC: `wc -l src/eucalypt.cljs`"; pnpm build | grep docs
